scene: A warm bite reveals a tiny rolled brass key hidden inside.
picture: Side-scrolling view along the zinc roof terrace at dusk. Far left stands the brass pastry robot holding an empty tray. In the centre, the grandmother in pink tracksuit holds a bitten croissant, her white dog sitting beside her. Far right, an open striped cargo gondola sways at a roof mooring post.
